_doc.id: unique task id; also the heading '#### <id> — title' in 2-tech-plan(.ai).md
_doc.side: fe | be | ai (ai = services/analytics; reviewed by the BE lead)
_doc.after: ids that must be MERGED into sprint-NN before this task starts
_doc.base: optional branch to start from instead of sprint-NN (stacked work)
_doc.effort: high only for design, money math, data correctness, auth, concurrency; else medium
_doc.leadModel: opus only for contracts, money/return math, auth, ops; else sonnet
_doc.manual: true = done by a human or outside the workflow; the watcher waits for its merge
_doc.size: expected changed lines; the developer stops at 1.5x and asks for a split
